items.title: What Does Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Risk From The New DDR5 ITC Case?
items.summary: Netlist has filed new patent infringement proceedings at the US International Trade Commission targeting Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) and other companies over DDR5 memory modules. The complaint seeks exclusion orders that could limit imports of certain high performance memory products used in HPE systems. Netlist is also pursuing cease and desist orders that may affect the sale and distribution of accused DDR5 modules in the US market. The ITC process introduces legal and...
